purpose: Draft D8c2b negative-synthesis ledger (#290): phase-labelled closure classes add no new classes, and two-interface continuation remains negative with an exact net-zero null match. D8c2 is not passed; a genuinely new relation is required.

entries.claim: Under the frozen D3 conjugate-boundary join, adding fold phase to canonical closure classes adds zero classes over 37,376 bases of length 3-5. A two-interface continuation (a->b->c, extension bound 2) remains negative: length-3 homogeneous mean K2=0.214 vs heterogeneous 0.071; length-4 0.550 vs 0.279; the net-zero null matches ZFA exactly over 4,608 bases.
entries.formal_scope: Finite twist words; frozen D3 join; canonical and phase-labelled classes; two-interface continuation. This is a negative synthesis, not a D8c2 pass. No Penrose, persistence, or physical claim.
entries.comparator: Exhaustive variants in diversity_advantage_variants.py and data/diversity_d8c2b_revision.json.
entries.kill_condition: Any phase-labelled class addition, any length where two-interface heterogeneous support has higher mean K2, or any null/ZFA continuation-set difference (which would reopen the revision).
